newsitem.title: USA: FP&L Turkey Point 3 nuclear unit trips off line.
newsitem.headline: FP&L Turkey Point 3 nuclear unit trips off line.

text.p: Florida Power & Light's 666 megawatt (MW) Turkey Point 3 nuclear power plant is in hot shutdown after the unit tripped off line Tuesday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday.
The unit, in Florida City, Fla., was operating at full power when it was manually tripped after several rods were dropped in the reactor core, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The commission said the unit would likely be able to restart today following replacement of "all rod control cabinet power supplies."
Turkey Point 4, the neighboring unit also rated at 666 MW, was operating at full power, the NRC said.
